name: @assesskit/custom-interactions
description: QTI 3.0 portable custom interactions for JavaScript and TypeScript: math entry for formulas in LaTeX and stroke writing for characters, each an AMD module that loads entirely from the item's package.
author: Fariz Wakan (https://github.com/luthfanwakan)

scripts.clean: node --eval "for (const path of ['dist', 'modules', 'tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo']) fs.rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: pnpm clean && tsc -b tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build-modules.ts
scripts.check:packages: pnpm build && publint --pack pnpm --strict && attw --pack . --profile esm-only --exclude-entrypoints ./modules/*
